content:
maya: Posted the postmortem for yesterday's authz outage -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3187. TL;DR: token validation skew + a missing audit scope caused elevated 5xxs for the API. Need owners + concrete due dates for follow-ups. @sam @olivia can you pick items?

sam: I can take the token validation fixes. Will open a PR today for the validation tolerance and add unit tests. ETA EOD Thursday.

olivia: I'll own the audit logging gaps (missing resource scope on a few codepaths). I'll draft the runbook update and a short integration test. Planning to finish by next Tue.

devops-bot: Created INF-3190 (token-validation: tolerance + tests) and INF-3191 (audit-logging: scope coverage) and linked to INF-3187.

maya: Thanks. Two extra asks: 1) we need a monitoring alert for the recurring pattern (seen similar spike in 3 incidents last 90d). 2) Add owner for secrets rotation verification — we had one expired service token that complicated rollback.

sam: For the alert, propose a prom query: `sum(rate(api_5xx_responses{route="/v1/auth"}[5m])) by (route) > 5`. Can also add a weekly signal check job. I can add the alert rule after the PR merges.

olivia: For secrets rotation verification, happy to own the process if chen can handle the automation job that verifies k/v TTLs.

chen: I can build a small lambda that runs nightly TTL checks + reports to #incidents and creates a ticket when TTL < 7d. Will aim for initial version in 4 business days.

maya: Great. Let's capture concrete due dates and owners in INF-3187 checklist: token fix -> sam (EOD Thu), audit runbook + tests -> olivia (next Tue), secrets-ttl checker -> chen (4 business days), monitoring rule -> sam (post PR). I'll add those items now.

sam: Quick note — the token edge-case only occurred when `iat` skewed > 2s due to NTP hiccup on a worker. Suggest we relax tolerance to 5s and record NTP drift metric. Code change is trivial but want opt-in behind a feature flag for 2 weeks.

olivia: Agree on flag. For the runbook: add step to check `ntp_sync` metric and fallback plan to rotate stale workers. I'll add an entry referencing the `infra/ntp` dashboard.

devops-bot: INF-3187 updated with assignees and due dates. Checklist items: token-fix (sam), audit-tests (olivia), ttl-checker (chen), alert-rule (sam).

maya: One more: add a recurring retrospective checkpoint for the next quarter to look for authz drift patterns. Can someone calendar a 30-min sync?

olivia: I can schedule a 30-min recurrence starting in 2 weeks and invite platform + sec-eng.

sam: I'll follow up on the feature-flag rollout plan in the PR description and tag @maya for approval.

maya: Perfect. Keeping this thread as the single source for aftercare updates — ping here when items are done and include the ticket link. :thumbsup:

chen: Noted, will post INF-3202 (ttl-checker) when ready.

sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/service/pull/622 — includes tests + feature flag toggle. Marking my checklist done in INF-3187.

olivia: Runbook updated and reviewed, pushed to docs repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/9f7a2b1. Marking audit-tests in INF-3187 in progress.

maya: Thanks everyone. We'll re-open if anything else pops up.
